bullets.title: Valentin Delluc: Speedriding in From Avoriaz with Love
bullets.note: This is one of the most terrifying and impressive things I’ve seen in years. Truly jaw-dropping, and the cinematography is gorgeous. Do yourself a favor, and instead of another cup of coffee, watch this three-minute video. Description: “This new project from speedriding pioneer [Valentin Delluc](https://www.redbull.com/ca-en/athlete/valentin-delluc) \[[@valentindelluc](https://www.instagram.com/valentindelluc/?hl=en)\] sees him flying into a deserted snow resort on his skis.”

bullets.title: The Boy, the Mole, the Fox and the Horse
bullets.creator: Charlie Mackesy
bullets.note: instagram.com/charliemackesy/)). This short and beautiful book was gifted to me by my mom. “This book is for everyone, whether you are eighty or eight,” as the Introduction puts it. It looks like a children’s book, and you can read it in 30 minutes, but it’s replete with wisdom for adults. To give you an idea of how popular this book has become, it has [62,862 ratings on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/Boy-Mole-Fox-Horse/dp/0062976583/ref=sr_1_2?crid=LQ1C3131FHMV&dchild=1&keywords=the+boy+the+mole+the+fox+and+the+horse&qid=1616514842&sprefix=the+boy%2Caps%2C210&sr=8-2) and an average of 5 stars.
